the capital multiplier below 1.0; weaker controls increase it. The BEICF
counterpart to :func:`business_environment_factor_bei`.

name: it_risk_scoring
summary: IT operational-risk score from availability, incidents and patching.
description:
Blends system availability (fraction), incident frequency and patch
compliance (fraction) into a 0-100 IT-risk score (higher = worse) with a RAG
band.

name: key_risk_indicator_kri_library
summary: Validate and index a KRI library.
description:
Each KRI definition must carry a ``name``, a numeric ``amber_threshold`` and
``red_threshold``, and a ``direction`` (``"higher_breach"`` or
``"lower_breach"``). Returns a validated registry keyed by name.

name: kri_threshold_breach_detection
summary: Classify a KRI value into a green/amber/red status.
description:
For ``higher_breach`` KRIs (higher = worse, e.g. failed trades) the value
crosses amber then red as it rises; for ``lower_breach`` KRIs (lower = worse,
e.g. staffing level) it crosses as it falls.

name: kri_trend_analysis
summary: Linear-trend analysis of a KRI time series.
description:
Fits an OLS slope to the observation series and classifies the trend as
``"deteriorating"``, ``"improving"`` or ``"stable"`` based on the slope sign
and the metric direction.

name: loss_data_collection_framework
summary: Internal loss-data collection above a reporting threshold.
description:
Filters loss events at or above the firm's de-minimis reporting threshold and
summarises count and total — the internal loss dataset feeding the LDA.

name: loss_distribution_approach_lda
summary: End-to-end Loss Distribution Approach capital estimate.
description:
Fits the frequency (Poisson) and severity (lognormal) distributions from
historical data, simulates the compound distribution and reads OpVaR /
capital at the regulatory confidence — the full LDA pipeline in one call.

name: loss_event_classification_basel
summary: Classify a loss event into a Basel II Level-1 event-type category.
description:
Validates the event type against the seven Basel II Level-1 categories
(BCBS 128, Annex 9) and returns its ordinal index for downstream bucketing.

name: model_risk_assessment
summary: Model risk tier from materiality, complexity, and validation quality.
description:
Combines model materiality and complexity (1-5 each) into an inherent score,
then discounts by validation quality (in [0, 1]) to a residual model-risk
tier (SR 11-7 / PRA SS1/23 style).

name: monte_carlo_oprisk_capital
summary: Monte Carlo OpRisk regulatory capital (OpVaR + expected shortfall).
description:
Builds the compound loss distribution and reads the loss quantile at the
regulatory confidence (Basel AMA uses 99.9% over a one-year horizon). Capital
is the unexpected loss = OpVaR minus expected loss.

name: near_miss_capture_framework
summary: Summarise captured near-miss events.
description:
A near-miss is an event with zero actual loss but a non-zero potential loss.
Validates events and summarises the count and aggregate potential loss — a
leading indicator of control weakness.

name: operational_var_opvar
summary: Operational VaR from an empirical aggregate-loss sample.
description:
Reads the loss quantile at the confidence level directly from a supplied
(e.g. simulated or historical) annual-loss array — the generic OpVaR reader.

name: oprisk_capital_allocation
summary: Allocate total OpRisk capital across business lines (pro-rata by risk).
description:
Distributes the firm-wide capital to business lines in proportion to their
standalone risk contributions, so the allocations sum exactly to the total —
a coherent (additive) allocation.

name: oprisk_economic_capital
summary: OpRisk economic capital (unexpected loss net of mitigants).
description:
Economic capital is the unexpected loss (OpVaR − expected loss) reduced by
recognised risk mitigants (insurance recoveries and diversification), floored
at zero.

name: oprisk_heat_map_generator
summary: Generate a 5×5 OpRisk heat-map distribution.
description:
Buckets each (likelihood, impact) risk into the 5×5 grid and computes the
score (likelihood × impact) and RAG band for each, plus a count matrix of
risks per cell.

name: oprisk_stress_testing
summary: OpRisk stress-testing capital projection.
description:
Projects stressed capital by scaling the base capital for shocks to event
frequency and severity. Because aggregate loss scales (approximately)
multiplicatively in both drivers, stressed capital =
``base × (1 + freq_shock) × (1 + sev_shock)``.

name: rcsa_control_effectiveness
summary: Composite control effectiveness from design and operating effectiveness.
description:
Combines design effectiveness (is the control well-designed?) and operating
effectiveness (does it operate as intended?) into a single [0, 1] score via a
weighted average.

name: rcsa_inherent_risk_scoring
summary: Inherent risk score on the 5×5 RCSA heat map.
description:
Inherent risk is the gross exposure before controls: ``likelihood × impact``
on the 1-5 scale, giving a 1-25 score mapped to a RAG band.

name: rcsa_residual_risk_scoring
summary: Residual risk after control mitigation.
description:
Residual = ``inherent × (1 − control_effectiveness)``: effective controls
reduce the inherent score toward zero. The residual is mapped to a RAG band.

name: rcsa_risk_identification
summary: Validate and summarise an RCSA risk register.
description:
Checks each risk entry exposes a ``risk_id`` and a Basel ``category`` and
summarises counts by category — the identification step of the RCSA cycle.

name: regulatory_compliance_score
summary: Weighted regulatory-compliance score.
description:
Computes the weighted fraction of regulatory requirements met (each 0 = not
met, 1 = met, or a partial value in between) as a 0-100 compliance score with
a RAG band.

name: risk_appetite_statement_oprisk
summary: Assess an OpRisk metric against appetite and tolerance limits.
description:
Maps a metric to ``within_appetite`` / ``within_tolerance`` / ``breach``
against a two-tier limit structure: appetite (the desired ceiling) and
tolerance (the absolute maximum before escalation).

name: root_cause_analysis_template
summary: Aggregate root-cause contributions into a normalised attribution.
description:
Normalises the supplied causal-factor weights (e.g. people, process,
systems, external) to sum to 1 and identifies the dominant root cause — the
quantitative backbone of an RCA template.

name: scenario_analysis_oprisk
summary: Scenario-based OpRisk capital via a compound Monte Carlo.
description:
Builds a single scenario's aggregate annual loss distribution from its
calibrated frequency and lognormal severity and reads the loss quantile —
the scenario's contribution to capital. Per RULE 3 randomness is pre-drawn
in pure Python.

name: scenario_expert_elicitation_model
summary: Aggregate expert loss estimates into a consensus with dispersion.
description:
Combines multiple experts' point estimates into a weighted consensus and
reports the dispersion (weighted standard deviation) as a confidence proxy —
wide disagreement signals an unreliable scenario.

name: scenario_frequency_estimation
summary: Estimate a scenario's annual frequency (Poisson lambda).
description:
Uses the expert's expected events per year directly, or — if historical
occurrence data is supplied — the empirical rate ``occurrences /
observation_years``. The result is the Poisson lambda feeding the scenario's
compound loss.

name: scenario_severity_estimation
summary: Calibrate a lognormal severity from expert typical / worst-case losses.
description:
Treats ``typical_loss`` as the lognormal median (so ``mu = ln(typical)``) and
solves for ``sigma`` from the worst-case percentile:
``sigma = (ln(worst) − mu) / z_p``. This is the standard two-point expert
calibration for scenario severities.

name: severity_distribution_fitting
summary: Fit a severity distribution to individual loss amounts.
description:
Supports the lognormal (default, the OpRisk industry standard) by MLE of the
log-loss mean/sigma. Returns the fitted parameters and the implied mean
severity.

name: tail_risk_scenario_oprisk
summary: Tail-risk scenario capital uplift for OpRisk.
description:
Stresses the extreme tail by scaling losses beyond the tail quantile by a
``severity_multiplier`` (e.g. a "perfect-storm" amplification) and re-reading
the stressed tail expectation. Reports the uplift over the unstressed tail.

name: third_party_vendor_risk
summary: Third-party / vendor risk score.
description:
Weighted index of vendor criticality (1-5), inverse financial health,
concentration and inverse substitutability — all normalised to a 0-100 score
(higher = worse).

name: active_share
summary: Active share — fraction of holdings differing from the benchmark.
description:
``0.5 * sum(|w_i - b_i|)``; 0 means identical to benchmark, 1 means fully
differentiated (Cremers & Petajisto).

name: average_drawdown
summary: Average drawdown — mean of the drawdown series magnitude.

name: black_litterman_model
summary: Black-Litterman posterior expected returns and weights.
description:
Combines the CAPM-implied equilibrium returns ``Π = λ Σ w_mkt`` with
investor views ``P E[r] = Q`` to produce posterior expected returns and the
corresponding mean-variance weights.

name: calmar_ratio
summary: Calmar ratio — annualised return over maximum drawdown.

name: carbon_footprint_attribution
summary: Carbon footprint attribution (WACI and financed emissions).
description:
Computes the Weighted Average Carbon Intensity (WACI) and attributes the
financed emissions to each holding by its invested value. Contributions sum
to the total financed emissions.

name: carhart_4_factor_model
summary: Carhart 4-factor regression (MKT, SMB, HML, MOM).
description: Extends Fama-French 3-factor with the momentum (WML/MOM) factor.

name: concentration_risk_hhi
summary: Concentration risk via the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI).
description:
``HHI = sum(w_i^2)`` on absolute weights normalised to sum to 1. Ranges from
``1/n`` (equal weight) to 1 (single holding). The effective number of
holdings is ``1/HHI``.

name: conditional_drawdown_at_risk
summary: Conditional Drawdown at Risk (CDaR).
description:
The mean of the worst ``(1 - confidence_level)`` fraction of drawdowns —
the drawdown analogue of Expected Shortfall (Chekhlov, Uryasev, Zabarankin).

name: correlation_clustering
summary: Correlation-based clustering of assets.
description:
Builds the correlation distance ``sqrt(2(1 - rho))`` and performs simple
single-linkage agglomerative clustering down to ``n_clusters`` groups —
grouping assets that co-move.

name: correlation_matrix_portfolio
summary: Correlation matrix and average pairwise correlation of asset returns.

name: currency_attribution
summary: Currency attribution (Karnosky-Singer style).
description:
Splits the base-currency return into a local-market component and a currency
(FX) component per holding, weighted by exposure. The total reconciles to
the weighted base-currency return.

name: cvar_constrained_optimisation
summary: CVaR-constrained portfolio optimisation (Rockafellar-Uryasev).
description:
Maximises expected return subject to the portfolio CVaR (at
``confidence_level``) not exceeding ``cvar_limit``, long-only and fully
invested. CVaR is computed empirically over the supplied scenarios.

name: diversification_ratio
summary: Diversification ratio — weighted average vol over portfolio vol.
description:
``(w' σ) / sqrt(w' Σ w)`` where ``σ`` is the vector of asset volatilities.
Always >= 1; higher means more diversification benefit (Choueifaty).

name: drawdown_duration
summary: Drawdown duration — longest and current underwater run lengths.
description: Counts consecutive periods spent below the prior peak.

name: equal_weight_portfolio
summary: Equal-weight (1/N) portfolio.

name: esg_score_integration
summary: ESG score integration — weighted score and optional ESG-constrained tilt.
description:
Computes the weighted-average portfolio ESG score. If ``min_esg_score`` and
a covariance matrix are supplied, solves a minimum-variance long-only
portfolio subject to the weighted ESG score meeting the floor.

name: factor_based_optimisation
summary: Factor-based minimum-risk optimisation.
description:
Builds the asset covariance from a factor model
``Σ = B F Bᵀ + diag(specific_var)`` and finds the long-only fully-invested
minimum-variance portfolio, optionally matching ``target_exposures`` to the
factors via an equality constraint.

name: factor_exposure_analysis_barra
summary: Barra-style portfolio factor exposure.
description:
Aggregates per-asset factor loadings into portfolio-level exposures
``Bᵀ w`` — the active/absolute factor tilts of the portfolio.

name: factor_return_attribution
summary: Factor return attribution.
description:
Decomposes the realised portfolio return into per-factor contributions
``exposure_i * factor_return_i`` plus a specific (idiosyncratic) component.

name: fama_french_3_factor_model
summary: Fama-French 3-factor regression (MKT, SMB, HML).
description:
Regresses portfolio excess returns on the market, size (SMB) and value
(HML) factors. The intercept is the factor alpha.

name: fama_french_5_factor_model
summary: Fama-French 5-factor regression (MKT, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA).
description: Adds profitability (RMW) and investment (CMA) factors to the 3-factor model.

name: gics_sector_exposure
summary: GICS sector exposure aggregation.
description:
Aggregates position weights into GICS sector buckets and reports each
sector's share of the portfolio. Shares sum to the total invested weight.

name: information_ratio
summary: Information ratio — active return over tracking error.

name: jensens_alpha
summary: Jensen's alpha from the CAPM single-factor regression.
description:
``alpha = mean(r - rf) - beta * mean(b - rf)`` per period; annualised by
multiplication by ``periods_per_year``.

name: liquidity_adjusted_portfolio_var
summary: Liquidity-adjusted parametric VaR (LVaR).
description:
Adds a liquidity cost term equal to half the weighted bid-ask spread to the
parametric delta-normal VaR (Bangia-Diebold-Schuermann simplified add-on),
capturing the cost of unwinding positions.

name: marginal_contribution_to_risk
summary: Marginal and component contribution to portfolio volatility risk.
description:
Marginal contribution ``(Σw)_i / sigma_p``; component ``w_i * marginal_i``.
Component contributions sum exactly to the portfolio volatility (Euler).

name: maximum_drawdown
summary: Maximum drawdown — largest peak-to-trough decline.

name: maximum_sharpe_ratio_portfolio
summary: Maximum Sharpe ratio (tangency) portfolio.
description: Maximises the annualised Sharpe ratio subject to weights summing to 1.

name: mean_variance_optimisation
summary: Mean-variance (Markowitz) optimisation.
description:
Maximises ``w'μ - 0.5 * λ * w'Σw`` subject to weights summing to 1, with an
optional long-only constraint.

name: minimum_variance_portfolio
summary: Global minimum-variance portfolio.
description:
Minimises ``w'Σw`` subject to weights summing to 1. With shorting allowed
the closed-form solution ``Σ⁻¹1 / (1'Σ⁻¹1)`` is used; long-only uses SLSQP.

name: monte_carlo_portfolio_simulation
summary: Monte Carlo portfolio simulation of terminal P&L.
description:
Draws correlated multivariate-normal asset returns (RULE 3: pre-drawn in
pure Python via Cholesky), compounds them over the horizon in a JIT kernel,
and reports the simulated VaR / ES of terminal P&L.

name: omega_ratio
summary: Omega ratio — probability-weighted gains over losses about a threshold.
description: ``Omega = sum(max(r - threshold, 0)) / sum(max(threshold - r, 0))``.

name: portfolio_beta
summary: Portfolio beta — sensitivity of portfolio returns to the benchmark.
description: ``beta = cov(r, b) / var(b)``.

name: portfolio_turnover
summary: Portfolio turnover — one-way traded fraction between two weight vectors.
description: ``0.5 * sum(|w_after - w_before|)`` (one-way convention).

name: principal_component_analysis
summary: Principal Component Analysis of an asset return matrix.
description:
Eigendecomposes the covariance matrix to extract orthogonal principal
components ordered by explained variance.

name: rebalancing_optimiser
summary: Rebalancing optimiser with a no-trade band.
description:
Computes the trades to move from current to target weights, suppressing
trades within ``no_trade_band`` to avoid churn, and reports turnover and
total transaction cost.

name: regime_detection_hmm
summary: Two-state Gaussian regime detection (HMM-style mixture).
description:
Fits a two-component Gaussian mixture by EM and labels each observation by
its most likely regime. The higher-variance component is reported as the
"stress" regime — the standard calm/turbulent market characterisation.

name: resampled_efficient_frontier
summary: Resampled efficient frontier (Michaud) minimum-variance point.
description:
Bootstraps return samples from the estimated multivariate-normal, solves the
minimum-variance long-only portfolio on each resample, and averages the
weights — reducing estimation-error sensitivity. All randomness is pre-drawn
in pure Python (RULE 3).

name: residual_risk
summary: Residual (idiosyncratic) risk — volatility of single-factor regression residuals.
description:
Regresses portfolio returns on the benchmark (CAPM) and reports the
standard deviation of the residuals — the risk not explained by beta.

name: return_attribution_brinson
summary: Brinson-Hood-Beebower return attribution.
description:
Decomposes the active return into allocation, selection and interaction
effects per segment. The three effects sum exactly to the total active
return — the reconciliation property required for performance reporting.

name: risk_parity_portfolio
summary: Equal risk contribution (risk parity) portfolio.
description:
Finds long-only weights so each asset contributes equally to portfolio
variance, by minimising the dispersion of risk contributions.

name: robust_portfolio_optimisation
summary: Robust mean-variance optimisation with a box uncertainty set on means.
description:
Uses the worst-case expected return ``μ - κ·diag(Σ)^{1/2}`` within an
ellipsoidal/box uncertainty set (Tütüncü-Koenig style), then solves the
standard mean-variance problem — producing more conservative weights.

name: sector_attribution
summary: Sector attribution — Brinson allocation/selection grouped by sector.
description:
A thin specialisation of :func:`return_attribution_brinson` where segments
are GICS sectors. Allocation+selection+interaction reconcile to the active
return.

name: sharpe_ratio
summary: Annualised Sharpe ratio.
description:
Mean excess return divided by return volatility, annualised by
``sqrt(periods_per_year)``.

name: sortino_ratio
summary: Annualised Sortino ratio.
description:
Like Sharpe but penalises only downside deviation below ``target``, so
upside volatility is not treated as risk.

name: tail_ratio
summary: Tail ratio — magnitude of the right tail relative to the left tail.
description:
``|quantile(1 - tail)| / |quantile(tail)|``. A value above 1 indicates the
right (gain) tail is larger than the left (loss) tail.

name: tracking_error
summary: Tracking error — volatility of active (portfolio minus benchmark) return.

name: transaction_cost_analysis
summary: Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) — implementation shortfall vs benchmark.
description:
Computes per-trade slippage against an arrival/VWAP benchmark and the
quantity-weighted average slippage in basis points. ``side`` is +1 for
buys (paying above benchmark is a cost) and -1 for sells.

name: treynor_ratio
summary: Treynor ratio — annualised excess return per unit of systematic risk (beta).

name: ulcer_index
summary: Ulcer Index — root-mean-square of percentage drawdowns from peak.
description:
A depth-and-duration-sensitive risk measure: deeper, longer drawdowns are
penalised quadratically.

name: aifmd_risk_metrics
summary: AIFMD Annex IV risk metrics — leverage and (optional) VaR.
description:
Computes leverage under the gross method and the commitment method (each as
a multiple of NAV) per Delegated Regulation 231/2013 Art. 7-8. A fund is
"substantially leveraged" when commitment leverage exceeds 3x NAV.

name: basel_iii_cet1_ratio
summary: Basel III Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio.
description: ``CET1 ratio = CET1 capital / RWA``; minimum 4.5% (Basel III §50).

name: basel_iii_leverage_ratio
summary: Basel III leverage ratio.
description:
``Leverage ratio = Tier 1 capital / total exposure measure``; minimum 3.0%.
The exposure measure is non-risk-weighted (on + off balance sheet).

name: basel_iii_tier1_ratio
summary: Basel III Tier 1 capital ratio.
description: ``Tier 1 ratio = Tier 1 capital / RWA``; minimum 6.0% (Basel III §50).

name: basel_iii_total_capital_ratio
summary: Basel III Total capital ratio.
description: ``Total ratio = (Tier 1 + Tier 2) / RWA``; minimum 8.0% (Basel III §50).

name: basel_iv_output_floor
summary: Basel IV output floor.
description:
Floored RWA = ``max(internal_model_rwa, floor_factor * standardised_rwa)``.
The floor factor is 72.5% (Basel III finalisation) — do not relax.

name: capital_conservation_buffer
summary: Capital Conservation Buffer (CCoB) and distribution constraint.
description:
The 2.5% CET1 buffer above the 4.5% minimum. Breaching the buffer triggers
Maximum Distributable Amount (MDA) restrictions on dividends/bonuses.

name: combined_buffer_requirement
summary: Combined Buffer Requirement (CBR).
description:
``CBR = CCoB + CCyB + max(G-SII, O-SII, SyRB)`` per CRD IV. Sums the buffer
ratios and (optionally) the capital amount on the supplied RWA.

name: countercyclical_capital_buffer
summary: Institution-specific Countercyclical Capital Buffer (CCyB).
description:
The CCyB rate is the exposure-weighted average of the national CCyB rates
applied to the bank's private-sector credit exposures (CRD IV Art. 140).

name: crr2_large_exposure_limit
summary: CRR2 large exposure limit (Art. 395).
description:
A single client / group exposure must not exceed 25% of Tier 1 capital
(or EUR 150m for institutions, whichever is higher — simplified to the 25%
ratio test here). Reports the exposure ratio and any breach amount.

name: emir_clearing_obligation_check
summary: EMIR clearing obligation check (Art. 4 / Art. 4a / Art. 10 / clearing thresholds).
description:
[REGULATORY] EMIR REFIT (Regulation (EU) 2019/834) Art. 4a(1): a Financial
Counterparty (FC) that breaches its clearing threshold in ANY ONE OTC
derivative asset class becomes subject to the clearing obligation for ALL
asset classes it has positions in, not just the one that breached. Art.
10(1) evaluates a Non-Financial Counterparty above threshold (NFC+)
per-asset-class instead -- only the classes where ITS OWN threshold is
breached become subject to clearing.

A prior version of this function applied FC's per-class-only logic to
BOTH categories (took a single ``asset_class``/``notional`` pair,
identical branching for FC and NFC+ beyond the NFC- exemption). It
understated an FC's clearing scope whenever the breaching class differed
from the queried class -- masked in the original test, which happened to
query the same class that breached. Found during the Tier 3 #2 audit.

name: emir_margin_requirement
summary: EMIR (Art. 11) uncleared-derivatives margin requirement.
description:
Computes the Initial Margin (IM) from the rate and the net margin call after
applying the Minimum Transfer Amount (MTA) to the variation margin.

name: emir_trade_repository_report
summary: EMIR trade repository report builder/validator.
description:
Validates the core EMIR reporting fields (counterparty LEIs, UTI, notional,
asset class) and echoes a normalised report.

name: frtb_ima_market_risk_capital
summary: FRTB Internal Models Approach total market-risk capital.
description:
The IMA charge combines the multiplier-scaled, stressed-scaled Expected
Shortfall (the "IMCC" proxy) with the non-modellable risk factor capital
(SES) and the Default Risk Charge (BCBS d457 §189). The multiplier is
floored at 1.5.

name: frtb_pl_attribution_test
summary: FRTB P&L Attribution Test (PAT) — Spearman correlation + variance ratio.
description:
Jointly evaluates the Spearman rank correlation between risk-theoretical P&L
(RTPL) and hypothetical P&L (HPL) and the volatility ratio
``std(RTPL)/std(HPL)``, assigning the Basel traffic-light zone. The
thresholds are mandated by BCBS d457 and CLAUDE.md §4.4:
green ``|corr|>=0.80 AND 0.8<=ratio<=1.2``;
amber ``|corr|>=0.70 AND 0.6<=ratio<=1.5``; otherwise red (IMA loss).

name: frtb_sa_market_risk_capital
summary: FRTB Standardised Approach total market-risk capital.
description:
The SA capital is the simple sum of the Sensitivities-Based Method charge
(already aggregated across delta/vega/curvature and the three correlation
scenarios), the Default Risk Charge (DRC) and the Residual Risk Add-On
(RRAO) (BCBS d457 §2).

name: frtb_trading_desk_aggregation
summary: FRTB trading-desk capital aggregation.
description:
Aggregates per-desk capital: IMA-eligible desks contribute their IMA charge,
non-eligible (PAT-red / backtest-failed) desks fall back to the SA charge.
The total firm-wide market-risk capital is the sum across desks (BCBS d457
treats the firm charge as the sum of approved-desk IMA plus SA for the rest).

name: icaap_capital_assessment
summary: ICAAP internal capital adequacy assessment.
description:
Aggregates Pillar 1 capital with internally-assessed risk components
(credit concentration, IRRBB, etc.) and compares to available capital.

name: mifid_ii_algorithm_documentation
summary: MiFID II RTS 6 algorithmic-trading documentation completeness check.
description:
Verifies that the mandatory governance and control documentation items for
an algorithmic trading strategy are present.

name: mifid_ii_best_execution_metric
summary: MiFID II RTS 27/28 best-execution metric.
description:
Computes the quantity-weighted price improvement (or slippage) of executions
versus a reference (e.g. EBBO) price, in basis points. Positive means price
improvement for the client.

name: mifid_ii_post_trade_transparency
summary: MiFID II post-trade transparency / deferred-publication assessment.
description:
Trades above the size threshold (or in illiquid instruments) may benefit
from deferred publication; otherwise publication is near real-time.

name: mifid_ii_pre_trade_transparency
summary: MiFID II pre-trade transparency / LIS waiver assessment.
description:
Determines whether an order qualifies for the Large-in-Scale (LIS) waiver
from pre-trade transparency (illiquid instruments and orders above the LIS
threshold may be waived).

name: mifid_ii_transaction_report_validator
summary: MiFID II / RTS 22 transaction report field validator.
description:
Checks the presence and basic validity of the mandatory transaction-report
fields (LEI length, ISIN length, positive price/quantity).

name: pillar_2a_capital
summary: Pillar 2A capital — sum of individual risk add-ons.
description:
Pillar 2A covers risks not (fully) captured in Pillar 1: e.g. credit
concentration, IRRBB, pension, operational. Sums the component charges.

name: pillar_2b_stress_buffer
summary: Pillar 2B stress buffer (PRA buffer / capital guidance).
description:
The forward-looking buffer to absorb the peak capital depletion projected
under the supervisory stress scenario.

name: sftr_securities_finance_report
summary: SFTR securities-financing transaction report builder/validator.
description:
Validates the core SFTR fields for an SFT (repo, securities lending, buy-
sell back, margin lending): counterparties, UTI, collateral and the SFT
type.

name: solvency_ii_scr_credit_risk
summary: Solvency II SCR counterparty default (credit) risk — type 1 simplified.
description:
Computes the loss-given-default per counterparty and the capital charge from
the variance of losses, using the standard-formula risk factor on the
aggregate LGD (Delegated Regulation 2015/35 Art. 199-202, simplified).

name: solvency_ii_scr_market_risk
summary: Solvency II SCR Market risk — standard-formula modular aggregation.
description:
Aggregates the market sub-module capital charges (interest rate, equity,
property, spread, currency, concentration) using the prescribed correlation
matrix and the square-root formula ``SCR = sqrt(s' Corr s)`` (Delegated
Regulation 2015/35 Art. 164).

name: srep_capital_add_on
summary: SREP (Supervisory Review and Evaluation Process) capital add-on.
description:
Translates the supervisory Pillar 2A add-on ratio into a capital amount and
the Total SREP Capital Requirement (TSCR).

name: ucits_kiid_risk_indicator
summary: UCITS KIID Synthetic Risk and Reward Indicator (SRRI), 1-7.
description:
Maps the annualised volatility of (weekly by default) returns to the SRRI
bucket per CESR 10-673: class 1 (< 0.5%) up to class 7 (>= 25%).
